summary: lab-helper exfiltrates host data to hardcoded IP via install lifecycle hook
details: The package's install lifecycle script (sec_check.js, line 26) executes a curl POST request to a hardcoded raw IP address (http://18.175.63.47) when the package is installed. The use of an unbranded raw IPv4 endpoint over plaintext HTTP, fired automatically from an install hook (referenced at lines 2 and 30), is the canonical shape of a supply-chain exfiltration beacon — every installer running `npm install lab-helper` triggers an outbound POST to attacker-controlled infrastructure without consent. There is no legitimate purpose served by a generic 'helper' package contacting a bare IP at install time.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
